headline: President Bush amended an earlier order that set up a White House advisory committee on information technology.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13035, which created the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee. That committee gives the President advice on computing and information technology research. The title shows the order amends the earlier rules again, but no summary was provided, so the exact changes are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee
who_it_affects.how: The rules that govern their committee are changed, though the specific changes are not described in the available material.
